annotations.title: Get Lightning Lane prices and return times

description: Use this when a visitor asks what Lightning Lane (or Universal Express) costs at one supported park on a date, or which rides have Lightning Lane return times available now and how soon. Return times exist only for today; prices cover the next 30 park-local days. Parky cannot buy or book Lightning Lane.

date.description: Park-local date for prices, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today. Return times are only for today.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

ride_id.description: Optional canonical ride ID to return one ride's return window.

name: parky_get_lightning_lane
title: Get Lightning Lane prices and return times
